text:
Stop letting ChatGPT write like a robotic politician.

Add this simple trick to the end of your prompt for normal human writing.

How to use it:
• Add "Write this like a casual email to a friendly coworker."
• Tell it to "never use corporate jargon or fancy words."
• Ask it to "use short sentences and keep it ultra-simple."

The bottom line:
Your drafts stop sounding like a bot and start sounding like a real human in 5 seconds.

What word do you hate seeing in AI writing?
